description: ReleaseShield AI policy rule definitions for infrastructure governance

rules.name: Public IP / Open CIDR Block
rules.description: Detects unrestricted network access via 0.0.0.0/0 CIDR blocks
rules.remediation: Restrict source_ranges to specific IP ranges or VPN CIDRs

rules.name: Overly Permissive IAM Binding
rules.description: Detects IAM bindings granting access to allUsers or allAuthenticatedUsers
rules.remediation: Use specific service accounts or group bindings instead

rules.name: Missing Encryption Configuration
rules.description: Storage or database resources should have encryption enabled
rules.remediation: Add encryption block with CMEK or Google-managed encryption

rules.name: Missing Resource Labels/Tags
rules.description: All cloud resources should have labels for cost allocation and ownership
rules.remediation: Add required labels: environment, team, service, cost_center

rules.name: Overly Permissive Firewall Rule
rules.description: Firewall rules allowing all protocols or all ports increase attack surface
rules.remediation: Restrict to specific protocols (TCP/UDP) and required port ranges only

rules.name: Auto-Scaling Disabled on Node Pool
rules.description: GKE node pools without autoscaling may fail under traffic spikes
rules.remediation: Enable autoscaling with appropriate min/max node counts

rules.name: Public GKE Cluster (Missing Private Config)
rules.description: GKE clusters should use private_cluster_config to prevent public exposure

rules.name: Deletion Protection Disabled
rules.description: Critical resources should have deletion protection to prevent data loss
rules.remediation: Set deletion_protection = true for production resources
